0.0: Salutations, brave warrior! Did #b#p3001000##k send you? Perfect! I can't reveal the details, but we are doing some clandestine trades with the Novas. I'm afraid no adequate compensation was provided, though.
0.1: I'll give you some trifling tasks that will aid with the seal ritual, but you simply must assist us in recouping our losses. Think of it as... compensation for the trade. I'll even throw in a bauble or two for you to keep.
0.2: In any event, you will be working closely with us now... closer than ever! What say we expand our relationship, hmm?
0.3: I insist that you open a dialogue with #b#p3001006##k, our junior member. Render him some aid, yes?

yes.0: #b#p3001006##k is nearby. Go talk to him.

no.0: Well, you're free to refuse a fine trade like this, but I implore you to reconsider!

1.0: Welcome Kaiser! I have everything I should have, and nothing I shouldn't! My most popular item at the moment is a back-scratching cat!\r\n#L0##bYou must be #p3001006#, right?#l\n#k
1.1: Yep, I'm #p3001006#. Boss #p3001004# told me that you would be coming. You want that cat? If not, I might toss it.\r\n#L0##bUm...what were you saying about the boss?#l\n#k
1.2: Ah, it's nothing. I guess you'll be helping me out for a bit, so don't sweat it.
